item.title: Suspected drone activity forces US personnel to shelter at UK airbase
item.description:
US personnel were forced on Friday to take shelter at RAF Lakenheath, a major base hosting American forces in the UK, following "suspected unauthorized drone activity", reported Sky News.
No one was affected, nor was any aircraft. The incident came after the US military on Monday evacuated more than a dozen warplanes from a second, sprawling airbase in Suffolk, RAF Mildenhall, amid reports of a security threat linked to Iran.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)
